comment: Shell-facing registry of language modules. The shell reads this to render the sidebar + dashboard language cards WITHOUT loading the module bundle. 'type=local' modules live in this monorepo and are imported via a built-in importer keyed by 'id'. 'type=remote' modules are fetched from a separate deploy via 'manifestUrl' (see docs/adding-language-module.md for how to add one).
